newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, Mitsui Eng win Y20 bln Azerbaijan orders.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, Mitsui Eng win Y20 bln Azerbaijan orders.

text.p: Itochu Corp said on Monday that it and Mitsui Engineering & Shipbuilding Co Ltd had won two plant orders totalling 20 billion yen from the State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic.
The two firms jointly won a full-turnkey order to build a 13-billion-yen compressor for the Bakar offshore oilfield in the Caspian Sea.
The compressor will be used to enhance oil recovery from the field, an Itochu spokesman said.
The other order is for four 10,000 kilowatt power generators, worth seven billion yen in total, at the Neft Dashrari off-shore field.
The trading house has a 3.92 percent share in Azerbaijan International Operating Company, a multi-national consortium developing the Azeri, Chirag and Guneshli oil fields in Azerbaijan.
